name: Soft Pastel
signature: Blush page, raspberry accent, arch-cropped photo, pill buttons, floating cards.

contrast.note: Light theme. Raspberry is safe as text on both backgrounds. White on raspberry passes AA.

type.eyebrow: 0.875rem, weight 600, accent color, sentence case, with a small round dot before it

motion.rule: Float: cards rise 28px over 900ms with a 100ms stagger and a soft ease-out, never faster, never bouncing.

hero.layout: Photo cropped to an arch (border-radius 999px 999px 28px 28px) on the right, headline and pill button on the left, a large blob of surface color behind the photo.
hero.photo: Real, bright, warm photo of the shop, the animals, the flowers or the work.

background: Blush white with two large flat surface-color blobs (static SVG shapes) behind the hero and one mid-page section. No gradients.

button.fill: Accent fill, white label; secondary is a surface-color pill with ink label.
button.label: Weight 600, sentence case.
button.hover: Lifts 4px with data-lift; shadow is static.
